test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

After a long and __rigorous__ fast the Lord appeared before him.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lenient**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym **means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Rigorous **is an adjective which means extremely thorough and meticulous.

*Example *: The rules must be **rigorously **followed

 
• The word **Lenient **is an adjective which means kinder or more tolerant than expected.

*Example *: The judge was far too **lenient **with him.

 
• The meaning of word *Rigorous is opposite of the meaning of word Lenient*. Hence **Option 4 Lenient is the answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Exhausting **is an adjective which means very tiring.

*Example *: The day was really **exhausting**.

 
• The word **Sweaty **is an adjective which means soaked in sweat.

*Example *: We are **sweaty **after playing cricket.

 
• The word **Oppressive **is an adjective which means Using harsh and authoritarian methods.

*Example *: I feel that these laws are **oppressive**.
